revisions: 1: first frozen set (O1-O8, P1-P9); red run on 33c4652 at one sample per consumer: 32/34, P9 (Pi panel line held Opus at xhigh) and O1 on Codex (answered the seat description, effort right).

2: O1 and O8 ask for the exact alias or id rather than the seat's description (wording only; expectations unchanged). Added P10 and P11 for poteto-mode's per-job raise and lower, identified while reading its Subagents section before the red results arrived.

3: P1-P9 state that the job needs no per-job raise or lower (wording only; expectations unchanged). The 1.46.1 control on Claude failed unchanged cases P2 (opus @high answered medium) and P6 (Pi openai answered high) because poteto-mode lowers a review's level one step, which the text allows for an explicit level or a non-Opus model; the cases had not fixed the job. P10 and P11 test the job adjustment. Every run is repeated on this revision.

4: added O9-O12 (frontend subagent, ordinary worker, bounded worker, plan advisor), S1-S2 (setup-pstack's own wording) and P12-P18 (the Reasoning effort paragraph in each remaining changed skill), plus P19 (Codex runtime control), after independent acceptance on 366bd67 found those seats and files without a selecting case. Cases O1-O8 and P1-P11 are unchanged from revision 3, and their revision-3 runs are reused case by case.

5: moved the set into the repository (tools/routing-eval/cases.json) and added `anchors` outside the cases, mapping each case id to the verbatim passages that decide it, so `routing-eval.py check` can catch a removed or reworded passage without a model call. No case changed.
purpose: Expected-outcome eval of the routing text: does an agent reading the shipped skill text dispatch the expected model and reasoning effort for each seat? Expectations come from the owner's rules and the orchestrator's Defaults block, frozen before any run.
threshold: Candidate: every sample of every case passes on both consumers. Baseline control (the previous release's text, run with --baseline): every case marked changed fails on every sample, and every unchanged case passes, and no sample errors; a changed case that passes on the baseline does not discriminate: the control fails until the case is replaced or no longer marked changed. Only a full run (every case on both consumers) can meet either threshold.
sources_note: pstack cases include poteto-mode/SKILL.md because thermos and arena defer each subagent's reasoning level to its Subagents section, and the Claude Code and Codex hooks inject it every session. Sources are read from the commit under test with git show.
grading: Deterministic. Lowercase and strip backticks and spaces; a graded field passes when its value is in the expected list. Ungraded fields are recorded only.
